mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sample (device_name, slot_no, temperature, humidity, tvoc, eco2, sampled_at) VALUES (#{deviceName}, #{slotNo,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{temperature,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{humidity,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{tvoc,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{eco2,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{sampledAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, device_name, slot_no, temperature, humidity, tvoc, eco2, sampled_at FROM sample ORDER BY sampled_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
